title: plugin-charts / plugin-dashboard: a chart's data labels ignore the axis's number format, the tallest bar's label and a dashboard table's last column are clipped, and an all-zero chart draws bare axes
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C

This card holds rows 2–4 of #27355, HotCRM's browser pass on 18.2.0 (hotcrm#2320). Triage's per-row rule (comment on #27355, 2026-10-29T02:57Z) gives these rows their own card. Seat `domain:ui#5` filed it. Seats 1 and 2 confirmed no collision at 2026-10-29T03:56Z.

## Observed (18.2.0)

| Row | Observed | Report |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | A chart's data labels are not formatted: `174000` sits beside a `400K` axis. | [Marketing](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444160853) S14, [Revenue](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444188882) S18 |
| 3 | A dashboard table cuts off its last column. The tallest bar of a bar chart loses its value label. | Marketing S14, Revenue S18 |
| 4 | A chart whose values are all zero draws an empty axis. | [Service](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444034183) S13 |

## Read on `origin/main` `c4c515ad` (code only; not measured in a browser)

- **Row 2.** In `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`, the value axis ticks use `formatterFor(axis.format) ?? formatYTick` (≈L2186–2199). `formatYTick` is `Intl.NumberFormat(..., { notation: 'compact' })` (≈L2083). The data labels use `dataLabel(formatterFor(axis.format))` (≈L2321, ≈L3075, ≈L3266) with no fallback. With no authored axis `format`, the label prints the raw number while the axis prints `400K`. The likely fix is to have the label take the axis's own resolved formatter, so the label always reads in the axis's units. Whether the measure's field format (currency, percent) should reach both is for the dev to measure. Name it, and don't widen.
- **Row 3, tallest bar.** `LabelList position="top"` (≈L2323) draws above the bar's top edge. With the domain's max at the tallest bar, the label lands in the top margin and is clipped. The likely fix is top headroom when data labels are on: a margin, or a domain pad of `dataMax` only when `showDataLabels`.
- **Row 3, table.** The last-column clip is in a dashboard table widget. `ObjectDataTable.tsx` wraps in `overflow-auto` (≈L1152), so the clip is likely a fixed-width or grid cell parent that hides the scroll. Measure which widget HotCRM's dashboards use (`DatasetWidget` table mode vs `ObjectDataTable`) before choosing.
- **Row 4.** There is a recorded measurement in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (≈L1229–1233): "an all-zero BAR drew 5,128 ink pixels of axes and ticks — which is why bar is deliberately NOT touched here: its reader can already tell". Zero is a value, so a "no data" empty state over real zeros would be false. The seat's lean is **will not do** for bar, line and area, with that reason, unless the measured picture shows no zero baseline or no tick a reader can use. If the dev finds otherwise, record it as an open question with options; don't change it silently.

## Serial constraint

ui seat 2's #27347 (PR #27361, in contract review) edits `plugin-dashboard` `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `MetricWidget.tsx`, `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx`, `index.tsx` and `utils.ts`, and regenerates the sdui manifest. A change here that touches `DatasetWidget.tsx` or `utils.ts`, or regenerates the manifest, lands after #27361.

## Done looks like

- With no authored format, a data label reads in the same units as its axis (`174K` beside `400K`), and an authored format still wins.
- The tallest bar's value label is fully drawn.
- A dashboard table's last column is reachable: it fits, or it scrolls.
- Row 4 is answered: either changed, or "will not do" with the reason, in the PR and on #27355.
